title: Qamus particle typed edges + homograph function lattice (qamus.graph_edge.v1 extension)
description: EXTENDS the canonical qamus.graph_edge.v1 vocabulary (tools/build_typed_edge_crosswalk.py EDGE_TYPES / PARTICLE_EDGE_TYPES) with particle-specific edge kinds. One edge vocabulary, one row shape — this is NOT a parallel graph. Evidence modes are reused verbatim from qamus/schemas/typed-claim-contract.schema.json $defs/evidence_mode per docs/certification-authority.md (no fork, no new enum values). Candidate-vs-certified separation is structural: a certified edge REQUIRES a reconstructible evidence-bundle reference, and every iʿrāb-bearing certified edge additionally REQUIRES a two-vote artifact reference (certification-authority §2 rung 4). Executable enforcement: tools/validate_particle_projection_parity.py (self-tested, red-first, gated in tools/check_regressions.py).

evidence_mode.description: Verbatim copy of qamus/schemas/typed-claim-contract.schema.json $defs/evidence_mode — reused, never forked (docs/certification-authority.md §1).

edge_status.description: Verbatim copy of the canonical STATUSES list in tools/build_typed_edge_crosswalk.py.

node_type.description: Nodes exist only for identity-bearing objects (owner decision, flag D, 2026-07-29 steer §8): token occurrence, morpheme occurrence, entry, sense analysis, evidence artifact, public appearance. Relations are typed edges, never nodes. morpheme-occurrence carries morpheme-occurrence-level identity per owner model §7 (see $defs/particle_morpheme_occurrence).

particle_morpheme_occurrence.description: Morpheme-occurrence-level identity node (owner model §7; flag D, 2026-07-29 steer §8). A particle morpheme occurrence is an identity-bearing object distinct from its host TOKEN occurrence: stable id + exact base-letter span within the host + the host token occurrence address. Minimal by design — analysis facts (identity, function, governor, scope) attach via typed edges, never inline here.

host_occurrence_id.description: Canonical host token occurrence address, e.g. quran:2:284:10.

base_letter_span.description: Base-letter (rasm-letter) span of the morpheme within the host token, 0-based half-open [start, end).

component_surface.description: Exact rendered surface of the morpheme component, diacritics intact.

particle_edge_type.description: The particle-specific members of the ONE canonical edge vocabulary (PARTICLE_EDGE_TYPES in tools/build_typed_edge_crosswalk.py).

irab_bearing_edge_type.description: Edge kinds whose certified surfacing to a learner is an iʿrāb-bearing conclusion → token-layer two-vote artifact REQUIRED for certification (certification-authority §2 rung 4). coordination_edge is DELIBERATELY ABSENT (owner decision, flag B, 2026-07-29 steer §8): coordination is a typed Naḥw RELATION edge, not itself an iʿrāb class — it stays certifiable at the bundle rung, while the coordinated elements' case/mood/agreement/attachment facts remain iʿrāb-bearing through their own edges.

surface.description: Exact rendered surface of the occurrence token (diacritics intact).

component_surface.description: Exact surface of the sub-token component the edge is about (e.g. the clitic within a host token). Required for clitic_host_edge.

evidence_bundle_ref.description: Reference to the reconstructible evidence bundle (typed-claim contract row / fact-ledger id). REQUIRED whenever status is certified.

two_vote_artifact_ref.description: qamus.two_vote_artifact.v1 artifact_id. REQUIRED for certified iʿrāb-bearing edges.

adjudication_artifact_ref.description: Owner/scholar adjudication artifact id, when evidence_mode is owner_or_scholar_adjudication.

guards.description: Names of the guards satisfied when the edge was emitted; an edge with no satisfied guard is not emittable.

allOf.description: Structural candidate/certified separation: *_candidate_edge kinds may NEVER carry status certified and may NEVER carry certification refs.
ANY certified edge requires the reconstructible evidence bundle and a resolving evidence mode (certification-authority §3: assignment invalid without the bundle; unresolved may never certify).
Certified iʿrāb-bearing edges additionally require the two-vote artifact reference (rung 4: a declared gate string is not proof).
evidence_mode unresolved forces a non-certified status on every kind.

clitic_host_edge names the exact clitic component surface and joins the clitic occurrence to its host. SCOPE (owner decision, flag C, 2026-07-29 steer §8): rung-1 certification of this edge certifies ATTACHMENT GEOMETRY ONLY — which sub-token component attaches to which host, at which boundary. It does NOT certify the clitic's lexical identity, contextual function, governor, or scope; those travel on their own edges with their own evidence.
source_evidence_edge targets a source node; decision_or_two_vote_edge targets a decision node.
Occurrence↔appearance reciprocity plumbing: appearance edge goes occurrence→appearance; reverse edge goes entry→occurrence.

function_label.description: The candidate contextual function, e.g. nafiya (negative), mawsula (relative), istifhamiyya (interrogative), masdariyya, shartiyya, zaida.

guards.description: Conditions that must hold for this candidate to be viable in this occurrence.

defeaters.description: What would falsify this candidate — every candidate must be falsifiable.

allOf.description: A certified winning function is an iʿrāb-bearing conclusion: evidence bundle + two-vote artifact required; unresolved may never certify.

compatible_function.description: A certified genuine LAYERED function coexisting with the winning analysis (owner decision, flag E, 2026-07-29 steer §8). Permitted only when (a) explicit source support for coexistence (coexistence_source_support), (b) independent review (review_ref), and (c) no contradiction in the typed relation set — a compatible function may never duplicate a function_label of the mutually exclusive candidate array.

coexistence_source_support.description: Explicit source support that BOTH functions genuinely coexist here (condition (a)) — not merely support for the layered function alone.

allOf.description: A certified layered function requires its own evidence bundle + independent review + explicit coexistence source support; unresolved may never certify.

particle_function_lattice.description: Homograph candidate lattice: one particle occurrence carrying MULTIPLE mutually exclusive candidate function analyses (مَا: negative / relative / interrogative / maṣdariyya …), each with its own guards and defeaters. maxContains:1 applies ONLY across the mutually exclusive candidate analyses: at most ONE member of mutually_exclusive_candidates may ever be certified, with no escape hatch. Zero-or-more COMPATIBLE typed function facts within the winning analysis live in compatible_functions (flag E, 2026-07-29 steer §8), each certified only with its own evidence bundle, independent review, and explicit coexistence source support.

mutually_exclusive_candidates.description: Mutually exclusive candidate analyses — at most one certified winner, unconditionally.

compatible_functions.description: Zero-or-more compatible typed function/relation facts WITHIN the winning analysis — never alternatives to it.
